item.title: Rallying Cry – October 25, 2026
item.description: From breakthroughs in cancer treatments to heartwarming acts of kindness, today’s good news includes a melanoma vaccine slashing tumor returns and Ukrainian drones delivering baby food to occupied towns, while 53 rescued orangutans return to Borneo’s forests.
